narr: Summertime thunderstorms impacted Middle Tennessee on July 28, 2024. One of these typical summertime storms produced heavy rain in Macon County, causing flooding in the Lafayette area.
ev: Heavy rain in the Lafayette area caused flash flooding, forcing the closure of several roads in the area. Damages are unknown.

Flash flooding reported over several roads in southern Van Buren County. Roads included Old State Highway 111, Howard, Brockdell, and Fall Creek Road. Several pictures received from local emergency manager. Received a couple reports of rainfall over 5 inches in the vicinity, all of which occurred within a 2 hour time frame. Damages are unknown.
lsr: Several roads were closed temporarily due to high water.
